verdict.rationale: The axis applies, because event-driven rules and alerting are a fair capability for a search and analytics engine. The only signals are glancing: a community comment implies Elastic offers alerts, but only in paid tiers, and the docs mention inference ingest pipelines that process content automatically at index time. Neither shows a user defining rules that trigger actions. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a rules or alerting engine (watchers, alerting rules, connectors/actions), event-trigger configuration, action types, AI-native or agent-driven rule definition, and independent hands-on corroboration.
